option_relations.rationale: Primary iris B-cell lymphoma is a specific type of primary iris lymphoma, and the biopsy results confirm B-cell origin (CD20+ lymphocytes).
Primary B-cell lymphoma of the iris (CD20+) is a specific type of primary iris lymphoma, and the biopsy results confirm B-cell origin (CD20+ lymphocytes).
Intraocular marginal zone lymphoma (MALT lymphoma) is a subtype of B-cell lymphoma that can occur in the iris, making it a specific form of primary iris lymphoma.

Primary B-cell mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT) lymphoma of the iris is a specific subtype of B-cell lymphoma occurring in the iris, thus falling under the broader category of primary iris lymphoma.
